summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 earnings and announcing a new $1.3 billion share repurchase authorization, incremental to prior programs. The buyback may be modified, suspended, or discontinued any time; no specific expiry or execution plan detailed. The authorization follows flat EPS and 9.3% revenue growth, reflecting capital return focus. Watch for pace of repurchases and future balance sheet deployment.
